name: NEXTDC M3 West Footscray
notes: NEXTDC M3 at 25-27 Indwe Street, West Footscray (City of Maribyrnong): 100,000 sqm technology campus with 150MW campus capacity (trade press; IT load not published), construction began 2021 and M3 completed September 2022. In 2026 NEXTDC applied via the fast-track ministerial permit process (Ministerial Permit PA2604231) to expand M3 to roughly four times its current size, including increasing backup diesel generators from 40 to 100; local opposition reported.

name: Perri Projects PMDC West Footscray
notes: Proposed four-storey data centre (~A$1bn) on 2.72ha former woolstore site at 1 McArthur Street / 63 Sunshine Road, West Footscray (Maribyrnong); subdivision permit granted by Maribyrnong Council; proposal lodged with Victorian Department of Transport and Planning fast-track (DFP); 2026 protest coverage names the 'Perri Melbourne Data Centre' site; capacity not disclosed.

name: Telstra InfraCo Exhibition Street Data Centre
notes: Telstra InfraCo colocation data centre at 155 Exhibition Street, Melbourne CBD (City of Melbourne LGA); one of two Telstra InfraCo Melbourne data centres, interconnected via fibre with its Clayton counterpart; capacity not disclosed. City of Melbourne is reported (ABC, Feb 2026) to host ~20 data centres, mostly small CBD colocation; this and Vocus MEL03 are the two confirmed named facilities in the LGA.

name: Vocus MEL03 Melbourne CBD (530 Collins Street)
notes: Vocus carrier/data centre at 530 Collins Street, Melbourne CBD (City of Melbourne LGA); Vocus refitted the former ASX building in 2013 with build-out capacity of up to ~400 racks; 5G Networks' 'Melbourne Data Centre' is also hosted at the address; MW capacity not disclosed. Note: Vocus announced closure of a separate CBD data centre to make way for an office redevelopment (Baxtel), so the CBD estate is contracting; MEL03 remains listed as an operating facility.

name: AWS data centre Cobblebank (AWS Melbourne Region)
notes: AWS data centre planned on 13.2ha site at 54-80 Ferris Road, Cobblebank (City of Melton, ~40km west of Melbourne CBD); Amazon paid A$60.5m for the site in July 2023; part of the A$6.8bn AWS Melbourne Region (ap-southeast-4) investment; June 2026 reporting says Greater Western Water's Melton Recycled Water Plant (Mt Cottrell) will supply recycled water to the 'soon-to-be-built' facility from day one; no public MW figure.
No datacenter project evidence found in Merri-bek (Fawkner/Coburg/Brunswick); the nearby Campbellfield data-centre cluster sits in City of Hume, outside this LGA.

name: Leading Edge Data Centres Mildura (regional Tier III proposal)
notes: Company announcement (May 2021) said land was being secured in Mildura and planning applications had begun for regional Victorian Tier III data centres; no current facility or updated status was found in this pass, so the record is retained as a stale lead (C grade, unverified current status).

name: C Capital / Lendlease Beveridge Northern Freight Precinct data centre assets
notes: Lendlease (official media release) says it was appointed by C Capital to progress master planning and rezoning/infrastructure enablement for a 507ha Beveridge site (Mitchell Shire) with end value up to A$4.5b spanning logistics, industrial and data centre assets; data centre scope/facility not yet defined - master-planning stage.
